{{Spoiler}}

'''Golden pickled carrots''' are the secret preservation of the [[golden carrot]]. They heal {{Hp|4}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 10 minutes, twice as long as [[pickled carrots]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_pickled_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden carrot, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Night Vision for 10:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten. Making them grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
